title: Stand strong
summary: Courage, a clean road and real friends, all starting with a God who goes with you.

title: Strength that lasts
summary: Lead while you are young, lean on God when you are tired, and find rest in Jesus.

title: Made on purpose
summary: Genesis shows who made you, why you matter, and how God meets you on the run.

title: Wrestling and rising
summary: Jacob, Joseph and Moses learn that God is with them in the fight.

title: Led through the wild
summary: God leads, fights, feeds and shares the load with his people in the desert.

title: Strong and kind
summary: Help your enemy, drop the grudge, and walk with God's presence and blessing.

title: Words that stick
summary: God keeps his word, and his word is meant to live in your heart and your home.

title: Choose life
summary: Open hands, honest choices and everlasting arms underneath you.

title: Be strong and choose
summary: Joshua and Gideon learn a courage that rests on God, not on themselves.

title: Brothers for the road
summary: Real friendship is loyal, honest and willing to give something up.

title: Grow up listening
summary: Young Samuel grows by listening to God, remembering his help and praying for others.

title: The battle is the LORD's
summary: David faces a giant, keeps his word, spares his enemy and finds strength in God.

title: Show yourself a man
summary: David gives Solomon a charge, Solomon asks for wisdom, and Elijah learns that strong men need rest too.

title: The quiet voice
summary: God speaks in a whisper, humbles the proud, and opens eyes to who is really with you.

title: A father's charge
summary: Kings learn to give God a whole heart, ask for wisdom and keep their hands working.

title: Rebuild
summary: Exiles rebuild a temple and a wall with prayer, honest work and joy.

title: When it hits hard
summary: Purpose in the moment, God's strong hand, and friends who sit with you in grief.

title: Rooted and covered
summary: A covenant with your eyes, a Redeemer who lives, deep roots and a God who lifts your head.

title: Morning and night
summary: Sleep in peace, pray in the morning, and be honest with God when he feels far.

title: Unshaken
summary: Keep God in front of you, know he delights in you, and guard your words.

title: The Shepherd leads
summary: Psalm 23, line by line: rest, restoration, the dark valley, the table and goodness that chases you.

title: Be strong and wait
summary: Ask God to teach you, fear nothing, want him most, and wait with courage.

title: Strength and shield
summary: God is your strength and shield, morning comes after the night, and your times are in his hands.

title: Come clean
summary: Confess and be forgiven, let God guide you, and taste for yourself that he is good.

title: Steady steps
summary: God is near the brokenhearted and makes firm the steps of the man who trusts him.

title: A new song
summary: Wait for God, talk back to despair, be still, and ask for a clean heart.

title: When you are overwhelmed
summary: Throw your burden on God, trust him when afraid, and climb to the rock higher than you.

title: A Father for the fatherless
summary: Pour out your heart, thirst for God, and meet the Father who steps in where a father was missing.

title: Strength of my heart
summary: When body and heart fail, God holds. Count your days and live with an undivided heart.

title: Whose you are
summary: Guard your eyes, let God calm your thoughts, and know you belong to a compassionate Father.

title: Guard your heart
summary: God knows you are dust, satisfies your hunger, and asks you to guard your heart and trust him.

title: Words and company
summary: Choose your words, your friends and your temper, and do not make plans alone.

title: Work and listen
summary: Learn from the ant, stand by your brother in trouble, and listen before you answer.

title: Rise again
summary: Draw out wisdom, do what is right, honor everyone, get back up, and get good at your work.

title: Walls and seasons
summary: Walk in integrity, build walls of self-control, speak up for the weak, and trust God's timing.

title: Even if not
summary: Two are better than one, Daniel draws a line, and three young men stand firm before the fire.

title: Called by name
summary: Strength in quiet trust, a God who calls you his, and blessing for the poor in spirit and the grieving.

title: Blessed are
summary: Jesus turns strength upside down: gentle, hungry for what is right, merciful, pure and peacemaking.

title: Seek first
summary: Shine, pray in secret, watch your treasure, stop worrying, and put God's kingdom first.

title: Build on the rock
summary: Ask, treat others well, build on Jesus' words, and learn from his gentle strength.

title: Follow him
summary: Jesus is gentle with the bruised, looks for good soil, walks on the water, and asks you to carry your cross.

title: Serve and stay awake
summary: Jesus came to serve, meets you in people in need, warns about weak flesh, and stays with you always.

title: The man in the storm
summary: Jesus prays before dawn, calls sinners, calms the storm, weighs a man's soul, and tells tired men to rest.

title: Called by Jesus
summary: Honest doubt, a welcome for children, a blind man called up, the greatest command and a call to follow.

title: Peace and purpose
summary: Jesus gives his peace, mercy breaks like dawn, Jesus grows up, and real change shows in what you share.

title: Faithful in little
summary: Jesus withdraws to pray, sets the golden rule, and shows that big faithfulness starts small.

title: Count the cost
summary: Hold the word tight, stop for the hurt man, count the cost, ask your Father, and do not be afraid.

title: The Father runs
summary: A father runs to his lost son, one man comes back to say thanks, and Jesus prays for Peter before he falls.

title: Light that wins
summary: Jesus forgives from the cross, sets hearts burning, and shines in a darkness that cannot put him out.

title: Stay connected
summary: Known by the Shepherd, washing feet, staying in the vine, courage in trouble, and life together.

title: Church on the move
summary: One heart, steady growth, songs at midnight, a God who is near, and the joy of giving.
